text:
Ana (Growth): Quick heads-up — weekly KPI sweep found a mismatch in webinar conversion numbers between the dashboard and raw GA4 leads. Dashboard shows 28% conv last week, GA4 shows 19%.
Tom (Analytics): Which dashboard? link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/kpi-orbit
Ana (Growth): the 'Launch performance' board, top-right widget. Screenshot attached in thread. Also SFDC MQL count for webinar campaign is higher than GA4 by ~120 leads.
Sara (Demand Gen): Hitting this too. We pushed a retargeting post last Thurs — could be UTM tagging gone sideways. @Tom can you check utm_source/medium on GA4 export?
Tom (Analytics): On it. Quick check: looks like a recent URL param cleanup rule stripped 'utm_medium' for some traffic. Running raw clickstream query now:
```
SELECT event_date, count(*) FROM ga4_events
WHERE event_name='page_view' AND params.key='utm_campaign' AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY event_date;
```
Evan (Product Ops): FYI our inbound routing rule maps by campaign name + utm_medium. If utm_medium is blank it falls to 'organic' bucket which doesn't route to SDRs.
Lisa (Sales Ops): That would explain higher SFDC counts — sales still getting form fills via hidden fields. We need to ensure GA4 export includes the hidden form param mapping.
analytics-bot: Export job 2026-03-15T10:02Z completed — sample_rate=1.0, rows=1,234,567
Tom (Analytics): Found the issue — a CDN redirect we deployed stripped query params on 3/12 02:00 UTC. Patch rolling back that rule now. Reprocessing GA4 raw logs for 3/12-3/15; ETA ~45m.
Ana (Growth): OK plan: Tom will confirm repaired numbers and post a delta; Sara & Lisa coordinate whether to pause the retargeting creative until routing confirmed. Evan please add a short blameless note in Launch Postmortem doc.
Evan (Product Ops): Added a note and assigned follow-ups.
Tom (Analytics): Posted updated numbers in 45m, will also add a temp visualization comparing GA4 raw vs dashboard pipeline.
Ana (Growth): Thanks all :thumbsup:
